title: when the paper needs a figure but my sketch is a mess
caption: When the paper needs a figure, I would rather generate a draft I can still edit than use a flat image.
pinned_comment: Editable figure draft > flat image you cannot fix.
script_lines: when the paper needs a figure but my sketch is fighting for its life
